findings.title: Rate limiter allows one request too many
findings.description: In the moved SlidingWindowLimiter.allow(), the guard changed from len(hits) >= self.limit to len(hits) > self.limit, so the limiter admits limit + 1 events per window (remaining()/retry_after() still use the old boundary and disagree); restore >=.
findings.suggestion: Use `if len(hits) >= self.limit:` exactly as in the original implementation.
